title: semantic-role Mirror embedding
hypothesis: One shared token embedding table and output readout plus one small Givens coordinate per semantic role can preserve role-conditioned next-token distributions on unseen lexical fillers with lower actual inference payload than private role maps; unrelated role transforms need richer or private maps.
physical_object: One frozen 32x16 token embedding table and one frozen 16x8 next-symbol readout, shared across four roles
mirror_coordinate: One learned float32 Givens angle for each of roles patient, instrument, and location; agent is the base role
logical_multiplicity: Four role-conditioned input token embedding functions
targeted_literature: Attention as Binding: A Vector-Symbolic Perspective on Transformer Reasoning (arXiv:2512.14709)
A Unifying Perspective on Language Model Representations: From Filler-Role Structure to Mechanistic Interpretability (arXiv:2608.29034)
Weight Tying Biases Token Embeddings Towards the Output Space (arXiv:2603.26663)
Kronecker Embeddings: Byte-Level Structured Token Representations for Parameter-Efficient Language Models (arXiv:2605.29459)

task.aligned_teacher: Shared base embedding/readout with one role-conditioned Givens rotation of the first two embedding coordinates
task.independent_teacher: Independent random orthogonal input transform for each role
task.objective: Temperature-2 forward KL teacher/student next-token distributions multiplied by T^2

development.selection_metric: mean held-out teacher KL over all methods, teacher families, and both development seeds; top-1, payload, then runtime are tie-breakers

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: packed records charge shared embedding/readout, all role transforms/codes, role IDs, method, tensor names/dtype/shapes, dimensions and header
storage.resume: torch.save inference state plus optimizer moments and counters, reported separately
paid_objects: role coordinates or alternative role maps
all codebooks or role binding vectors if stored

metrics: per-role transfer to held-out filler IDs
actual total and incremental serialized bytes
inference_benchmark: Final role, batch 2048, 5 warm-ups and 50 timed CPU forwards with torch threads fixed to one
compute_proxy: per-example readout D*C MACs plus an implementation-independent operation-equivalent estimate for each role transform; report wall time and measured CPU throughput separately
success_gate: Each of three fresh aligned worlds: held-out KL <=1e-4, top-1 agreement >=0.99, ECE <= full-map ECE +0.02, actual total payload <=0.60x full per-role maps, and Mirror KL <= rank-2 output-LoRA KL +1e-4. A simpler control matching quality at lower/equal bytes and compute precludes Mirror-specific advantage.
failure_gate: Both development worlds miss either the absolute KL/top-1 quality requirement or <=0.60x full-map total-payload requirement; fresh stays sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic one-step next-symbol distribution, not natural-text language modeling
Aligned family is generated from the candidate Givens transform
Fixed 300-update learning-efficiency screen, not near-convergence capacity evidence
Independent random orthogonal maps test need for private role functions

development_selection_result.selection_rule: registered mean across all methods, both teacher families and both development seeds

amendments.timing: after development and before fresh access
amendments.change: Freeze registered development-selected LR 0.01 for all fresh runs; no model, seed, data, update, metric, or success-gate changes.
